annotation.title_clean: 康复辅助器具产业扩能提质三年行动方案（2026-2028年）
annotation.title_en: Three-Year Action Plan for Expanding Capacity and Improving Quality of the Rehabilitation Assistive Devices Industry (2026-2028)
annotation.authors_or_issuer: 民政部、国家发展改革委、教育部、工业和信息化部等（Ministry of Civil Affairs and 12 other national bodies）
annotation.summary_en: Chinese multi-ministry notice and three-year action plan to expand and upgrade the rehabilitation assistive device industry, including brain-computer interfaces, exoskeleton and care robots, and intelligent prostheses. It sets targets, incentives, standards, certification, quality supervision, financing, payment coverage and talent measures.
key_provisions_or_claims: By 2028: 6-8 key sub-sectors, 50 key technologies, 80 products, over 500 large firms, and at least 60 standards.
Prioritises R&D of exoskeleton robots, care and rehabilitation robots, intelligent bionic prostheses and brain-computer interfaces.
Accelerates mandatory standards for electric wheelchairs and recommended standards for wearable exoskeletons; builds classification and certification system.
Strengthens quality supervision: sampling, risk warning, defective product recall, injury monitoring.
Expands financing, insurance, health and long-term care insurance coverage; builds talent and professional titles.
